WITH step1 AS (
    SELECT 
        ID,
        AVG(PIC) as avg_pic,
        AVG(HGB) / AVG(HCT) as hgb_hct_ratio
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
),
step2 AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(hgb_hct_ratio) as avg_ratio
    FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
    SELECT 
        step1.ID,
        step1.avg_pic,
        step1.hgb_hct_ratio,
        step1.hgb_hct_ratio - step2.avg_ratio as diff
    FROM step1, step2
    WHERE step1.hgb_hct_ratio > step2.avg_ratio
)
SELECT 
    AVG(avg_pic),
    AVG(hgb_hct_ratio),
    AVG(diff)
FROM step3
